label: The Odyssey
seed_text: The Odyssey. Mythic action epic from Universal Pictures, written and directed by Christopher Nolan, rated R, 172 minutes. Based on Homer's ancient Greek epic poem. Cast: Matt Damon as Odysseus, with Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson, Lupita Nyong'o, Zendaya and Charlize Theron. Franchise status: original film (adaptation of a classic literary work), not part of a franchise. Synopsis: after the Trojan War, Odysseus, the king of Ithaca and a hero of the war, undertakes a long and perilous journey home. Along the way he confronts mythical figures and monsters, including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the sorceress Circe.

label: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
seed_text: Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Superhero action film from Sony Pictures and Marvel Studios, rated PG-13 for action/violence and some language; about 145 minutes. Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton (Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings), written by Chris McKenna and Erik Sommers. Cast: Tom Holland, Zendaya, Jacob Batalon, Jon Bernthal as the Punisher, Mark Ruffalo as Bruce Banner/Hulk, Michael Mando as Scorpion, Tramell Tillman, Marvin Jones III as Tombstone, and Sadie Sink. Franchise status: fourth Spider-Man film starring Tom Holland, part of the Marvel Cinematic Universe; sequel to Spider-Man: No Way Home. Synopsis: Peter Parker is now a full-time Spider-Man in a New York that no longer remembers who he is. The pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, while a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

label: Resident Evil
seed_text: Resident Evil. Survival horror film from Sony Pictures, written and directed by Zach Cregger (Barbarian, Weapons), rated R; about 90 minutes. Cast: Austin Abrams as Bryan, with Zach Cherry, Kali Reis and Paul Walter Hauser. Franchise status: new film adaptation (reboot) of the Resident Evil video game series, following the earlier Resident Evil film series that began in 2002. Synopsis: Bryan, a medical courier, is caught in a fast-moving race for survival when a horrifying night falls apart around him.

label: Verity
seed_text: Verity. Psychological thriller from Amazon MGM Studios, rated R for sexual content, some nudity, language, violence and bloody images; about 114 minutes. Directed by Michael Showalter. Cast: Anne Hathaway as best-selling author Verity Crawford, Dakota Johnson as Lowen Ashleigh, Josh Hartnett as Jeremy Crawford, with Ismael Cruz Cordova. Franchise status: adaptation of Colleen Hoover's 2018 best-selling novel; not a sequel. Synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh, a struggling writer, is hired to ghostwrite the remaining books of a famous author, Verity Crawford, and moves to the Crawford family estate. There she discovers a disturbing autobiographical manuscript containing dark revelations about the author and her husband.

label: Digger
seed_text: Digger. Satirical black comedy from Warner Bros. and Legendary, directed by Alejandro G. Inarritu, written with Sabina Berman, Alexander Dinelaris Jr. and Nicolas Giacobone; rated R; about 128-129 minutes. Cast: Tom Cruise as Digger Rockwell, with Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Sandra Huller, Michael Stuhlbarg, Jesse Plemons, Emma D'Arcy and Sophie Wilde. Franchise status: original film. Synopsis: Digger Rockwell, 'the most powerful man in the world', is a tycoon who sets out on a desperate mission to convince the world that he is humanity's savior, before the catastrophe he himself set in motion destroys everything.

label: Other Mommy
seed_text: Other Mommy. Supernatural horror film from Universal Pictures, produced by Atomic Monster and Blumhouse (James Wan producing), rated R for some bloody violence and language; about 93 minutes (unconfirmed). Directed by Rob Savage (Host, The Boogeyman). Cast: Jessica Chastain, Jay Duplass, Arabella Olivia Clark and Dichen Lachman, with Karen Allen and Arian Moayed. Franchise status: original film, adapted from Josh Malerman's novel Incidents Around the House. Synopsis: Bela, an eight-year-old girl, lives in a home strained by her parents' marriage problems. A sinister entity she calls 'Other Mommy' emerges from her closet, and its presence becomes an increasingly terrifying threat to Bela and her family.

label: The Social Reckoning
seed_text: The Social Reckoning. Drama based on real events, from Sony Pictures, written and directed by Aaron Sorkin, rated R for language; 112 minutes. Cast: Mikey Madison as Facebook whistleblower Frances Haugen, Jeremy Allen White as Wall Street Journal reporter Jeff Horwitz, Jeremy Strong as Mark Zuckerberg, with Bill Burr, Wunmi Mosaku, Betty Gilpin and Billy Magnussen. Franchise status: companion piece to The Social Network (2010), not a direct sequel. Synopsis: in 2021, a young Facebook engineer, Frances Haugen, recruits WSJ reporter Jeff Horwitz to help expose the company's closely guarded secrets, in the story behind the Wall Street Journal's Facebook Files investigation.
